meta.title: Melbourne Climbing Map
meta.methodology: Official venue pages are the primary source. OpenStreetMap/Nominatim is used only for geocoding and candidate discovery; public-wall coordinates may use climbing/community references. Prices and hours are not inferred when an official source is unavailable.
meta.experienced_view: V2 adds venue scale, route/problem richness, reset cadence, training boards and long-term pass pricing. Quantitative fields are only filled where an official venue source publishes them.
